title: Mount swarm autopilot on the CLI for every project root
acceptance: node tools/swarm.mjs autopilot --once runs start-ready against the project ledger

title: Mount integrated snapshot wiring on run CLI path
acceptance: node tools/swarm.mjs run MANIFEST applies integrated snapshots for jobs with after dependencies

title: Extract integrate path from swarm.mjs into swarm-integrate module
acceptance: swarm.mjs is split into guard, scope, run, integrate, board, spend, lanes and cli modules with no behavior change.

title: Rewire tools/swarm.mjs to import modular guard scope run integrate board spend lanes cli
acceptance: swarm.mjs is split into guard, scope, run, integrate, board, spend, lanes and cli modules with no behavior change.
The full suite passes, and two queue items touching different modules can build in the same wave.

title: Make build tickets own their test files in ticket-manifest prompts
acceptance: A build ticket writes or owns the test file that proves it, so there is no build → test → fix chain.
The critical path of a typical scope is shorter than before on the same input.

title: Invoke ticket replan from scope sync when a ticket blocks or fails twice
acceptance: swarm scope sync logs a replan event with the ticket id and reason.
A replanned ticket returns to ready with smaller files or a different lane.

title: Wire release train commands into swarm CLI entry
acceptance: swarm release-train status reports batched runner merges and the next bump from the live CLI.

title: Allow tested tickets on any lane after local verify passes
acceptance: Tested tickets can then be built on any lane, including Cursor and Hermes.

title: Raise or lower active worker limit based on CPU, RAM, and lane rate limits
acceptance: The worker limit defaults from cores and free RAM, raises while CPU and RAM allow, and backs off on pressure or lane rate limits.

title: Mount Split quality panel on the project page
acceptance: The project page at /project shows the Split quality panel with graded metrics.

title: Apply project priority when granting machine-wide lane slots
acceptance: A lower-priority project cannot take slots reserved for higher-priority active projects.

title: CI workflow template caches or mirrors Docker Hub images
acceptance: CI caches or mirrors images so Docker Hub rate limits don't fail runs.

title: Regression tests for failure regression stubs and lane pass routing
acceptance: Each new failure cause becomes a regression test, and lane pass rates feed routing.
